senses.sense_definition: A person who does not follow or believe in a specific religion.

examples.text: The historical text described how the crusaders viewed their enemies as <w>infidels</w>.
He was accused of being an <w>infidel</w> because he refused to participate in the traditional rituals.

senses.sense_definition: A person who has no religious beliefs at all.

examples.text: The philosopher was labeled an <w>infidel</w> by the local community for his lack of faith.
Many people who identify as an <w>infidel</w> prefer to rely on scientific evidence rather than religious doctrine.

senses.sense_definition: A person who does not believe in a particular principle or idea.

examples.text: He was considered an <w>infidel</w> to the cause of environmentalism because he ignored the recycling rules.
The group treated anyone who questioned their core values as an <w>infidel</w>.

senses.sense_definition: Relating to the rejection of a specific religion.

examples.text: The author wrote an <w>infidel</w> tract that challenged the established church doctrines.
His <w>infidel</w> views caused a significant scandal within the conservative religious community.
